status: Second exploratory follow-up, after original and first-upgrade test results were known
selection: Rank 12 neural candidates by mean validation RMSE over seeds 0 and 1. Select 3 RF candidates separately with the same two seeds. Add seed 2 for each selected configuration. Freeze all selections before test access.
information: Causal observed history only: last-30 summaries, first-10 sensor means, change from initial level, cumulative means/slopes, and observed cycle. No future rows, full engine lifetime, ID, or true RUL used as a feature.
baseline: Refit random forest on the same history features, with its own train-only standardisation and the same engine split. Also show original and upgrade-v1 scores separately.
postprocessing: All new neural and forest outputs clipped to [0,125], fixed before the experiment.
test: One descriptive evaluation per selected configuration. Include per-seed and equally-sized three-model ensembles. Do not select a seed on test score or continue this search after evaluation.
limitations: The old test set is already seen; expanded feature information and more tuning make comparison to original models exploratory. No independent generalisation claim.
